findings.text: The shared-level-array assertion cannot fail for this fixture: both archives are written by _resolve_archive from the same default radius and height, so a mutant that computes each panel's levels from its own archive (contour_levels(panel["flux"], 8)) still reproduces the expected levels exactly - measured, all three panel tests pass with that mutant (3 passed, 8 deselected; /tmp/review-niadpr/mut-m2.log) - which leaves the property the test docstring calls "the quantity under test" unpinned until a fixture whose two archives differ in flux exists.

The assertion that each panel carries one line contour on the shared levels does not pin the contour kind: axes.contourf yields exactly one collection carrying .levels, so a mutant replacing the draw_flux_contours call with a filled contour passes all three panel tests (3 passed, 8 deselected; /tmp/review-niadpr/mut-m3.log); asserting contours[0].filled is False would close it, and the repository's binding figure rule is that a scalar map is drawn as line contours, never filled.

justifications.durability: The panel test now pins the wall and the grid with a discriminating fixture (differing walls and grids fail a producer-wall mutant at line 362), pins both null sets by marker vocabulary and fill style with the counterpart's colour, and records the render's inputs in a sidecar the tests exercise; the merge path pins its compile evidence with a passing control and a refusal when no count is present. Two required properties remain unpinned: the shared-level-array assertion cannot fail against this fixture, and the line-contour requirement is unasserted, so half the figure-composition rule is guarded and a regression that fills the contours still passes.

The focused lane passes (11 passed in 14.10 s), and a capture with no compile count is refused by the covered test (:148). Nothing the node asserts failed to check.
justifications.fit: The change keeps the module's argparse-subcommand idiom (merge gains --compile-log; panel keeps its explicit inputs), draws through the shared nova.media painters with the level array computed once and required rather than defaulted, reuses _repo_relative for every recorded path, uses PEP 758 exception tuples and full type annotations, and introduces no plan or ticket identifiers in symbols, filenames or comments.
